title: Polynomial bound on proof length
statement: Fix a Boolean circuit encoding and an output-sensitive PCPP reduction for that encoding. There is a polynomial with natural-number coefficients such that, for every packed Boolean circuit, the proof length of the reduction’s PCPP description is at most the polynomial evaluated at the circuit’s size.
hypotheses_covered: An output-sensitive PCPP reduction for that encoding
